description: This source file defines the CartEventListener class, which implements the HttpSessionListener interface. Its purpose is to handle events related to HTTP session lifecycle, specifically to capture and save information about abandoned shopping carts when a session is destroyed.

classes.name: CartEventListener
classes.description: HTTP session listener that tracks session creation and destruction to save abandoned shopping cart data.

methods.name: sessionCreated
methods.description: Handles the event when a new HTTP session is created; currently logs activity but performs no other action.

methods.name: sessionDestroyed
methods.description: Handles the event when an HTTP session is destroyed; attempts to save the abandoned shopping cart to the database if available.
